items.title_en: Olympic skiing officials to introduce bizarre microchipping rule following 'penis-gate' controversy
items.title_zh: 继“阴茎门”争议后，奥运会滑雪官员将引入奇怪的微芯片规则
items.summary_en: Ahead of the opening ceremony of the Winter Olympics, officials of the prestigious sporting event have introduced a surprising new microchipping rule that's bizarre to say the least. While the big event to kick start the Milano Cortina games is being held at the San Siro on Friday (February 6), the competition itself actually got underway on Wednesday (February 4).
